facts.statement: The genus Longchengpterus was named in 2006 by Wang Li, Li Li, Duan Ye, and Cheng Shao-li.
facts.quote: The genus was named in 2006 by Wang Li, Li Li, Duan Ye and Cheng Shao-li.

facts.statement: The genus name Longchengpterus combines the old name of Chaoyang City, Longcheng, with the Greek word for wing.
facts.quote: The genus name is derived from the old name of Chaoyang City, Longcheng, and a Latinized Greek pteron, "wing".

facts.statement: The species name zhaoi honors Zhao Dayu, president of Shenyang Normal University and a founder of the Western Liaoning Institute of Mesozoic Paleontology.
facts.quote: The specific name honors Zhao Dayu, the president of Shenyang Normal University and a contributor to the founding of the Western Liaoning Institute of Mesozoic Paleontology.

facts.statement: Longchengpterus lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages of the Early Cretaceous in the Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: Longchengpterus, sometimes misspelled as "Lonchengopterus", is a genus of istiodactylid pterodactyloid pterosaur from the Barremian-Aptian-age Lower Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning, China.

facts.statement: Fossils of Longchengpterus date back approximately 120 million years.
facts.quote: Its fossil remains dated back about 120 million years ago.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen LPM 00023, found at Yuanjiawa near Dapingfanga, consists of a compressed incomplete skeleton and partial skull preserved on a single plate.
facts.quote: Longchengpterus is based on holotype LPM 00023, found at Yuanjiawa near Dapingfanga, a compressed incomplete skeleton and partial skull on a single plate.

facts.statement: The humerus is 88 mm long and features a low deltopectoral crest without a pneumatic foramen.
facts.quote: The humerus, 88 mm long, has a low deltopectoral crest and no pneumatic foramen.

facts.statement: The wingspan of Longchengpterus was about 2 meters.
While the pelvis is heavily damaged, a femur fragment with an estimated length of 91 mm is present.
facts.quote: The pelvis has been heavily damaged. Part of a femur is present, its estimated length was 91 mm.

facts.statement: Longchengpterus is classified within the family Istiodactylidae, sharing tooth form, tooth count, and a large skull opening with Istiodactylus.
facts.quote: Longchengpterus has been assigned to the Istiodactylidae sharing with Istiodactylus tooth form and count as well as a large skull opening.

facts.statement: A notable difference between Longchengpterus and Istiodactylus is the lack of a broad snout in Longchengpterus.
facts.quote: A notable difference is the lack of a broad snout.

facts.statement: Longchengpterus belongs to the family Istiodactylidae.
Longchengpterus is part of the superfamily Ornithocheiroidea.
The time range for Longchengpterus is estimated between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The fourth metacarpal is longer than the first phalanx of the wing finger.
rejected.quote: The fourth metacarpal is longer than the first phalanx of the wing finger.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'The fourth metacarpal is longer than the first'
